#!/bin/bash

mark started
trap 'exit 129' HUP

trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'mark "ended with status $?"' EXIT
cd <ROOT>/nodes/v-depool/scripts
./prepare_elections.sh

./take_part_in_elections.sh

[[ $status -ne 200 ]] || echo "$(date '+%F %T %Z') skipped: another run or an evernode command holds this node's election lock"
exit $status

nominator.program:
#!/bin/bash
# Direct-to-elector election cycle, written by evernode election start.
set -uo pipefail
mark() { printf '\n=== %s election run %s\n' "$(date '+%F %T %Z')" "$*"; }
mark started
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'mark "ended with status $?"' EXIT
cd <ROOT>/nodes/v-nominator/scripts
log=<ROOT>/nodes/v-nominator/elections/last-preparation.log
./prepare_elections.sh 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
case $status in
    0) ;;
    3)
        # An interrupted attempt leaves a half-signed request in the wallet.
        # Neither step adds a second one: both wait until it is confirmed or
        # the wallet expires it, an hour after it was made.
        echo "+++-INFO: preparation stopped at a pending request in the wallet;"
        echo "+++-INFO: the bid step waits for it too. Finish it with evernode stake confirm,"
        echo "+++-INFO: or it expires an hour after it was made."
        ;;
    *)
        # Most runs find nothing to prepare, and say so with the same exit code
        # a failure has: only a failure is worth a warning in this log.
        if ! grep -qE 'already participated in these elections|There is no elections now' "$log";then
            echo "+++-WARNING: preparation exited ${status}; bidding anyway, because a"
            echo "+++-WARNING: solo bid goes to the elector and does not depend on it."
        fi
        ;;
esac
if grep -qE 'recover_amount = [1-9][0-9]* nanotokens' "$log";then
    settle=${ELECTION_SETTLE_SECONDS:-120}
    echo "---INFO: waiting ${settle}s for the recovered stake to reach the wallet"
    sleep "$settle"
fi
./take_part_in_elections.sh
